artworks.title: Entrance of the Temple of Serapis at Pozzuoli
artworks.artist: Jean-Claude-Richard, Abbé de Saint-Non, after Hubert Robert
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an outdoor scene with a grand building to the left, adorned with a statue. Steps lead up to the building. In the distance, columns suggest classical architecture, surrounded by foliage. The painting style is detailed, capturing light and shadow on the surfaces and greenery. The color palette is sepia-toned. People are seen on the steps. The sky has clouds.

artworks.title: View in the Garden of a Roman Villa, with the Temple of Hercules Victor and the Temple of Portunus
artworks.artist: Jean-Claude-Richard, Abbé de Saint-Non, after Hubert Robert
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image showcases a historical architectural scene with a round building featuring ornate columns, arches with statues, people engaged in daily activities, and potted plants. In the background, there is a row of trees, a cloudy sky, and a smaller structure with a dog nearby. The artwork is primarily in brown monochrome with variations in shading, creating texture in the stone surfaces and vegetation. The color palette consists of sepia tones, resembling antique etchings.

artworks.title: Stairway in an Italian Garden
artworks.artist: Jean-Claude-Richard, Abbé de Saint-Non, after Jean Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a grand architectural and natural landscape. Fluffy clouds dominate the upper portion, giving a sense of a bustling sky. The sepia-tone palette lends a warm, nostalgic quality to the scene. The detailed brushstrokes capture lush foliage, trees, and architecture. In the foreground, detailed stone structures with a grand doorway and sculptures are surrounded by flowering bushes. Further back, there are elegant stairs with a few people, tall trees, and ornate architectural ruins in the distance.

artworks.title: View of an Antique Fountain
artworks.artist: Jean-Claude-Richard, Abbé de Saint-Non, after Hubert Robert
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural structure with a grand archway, a fountain, carvings, and vegetation. Figures are seen around the structure, which is depicted in warm sepia tones with intricate details. The scene also includes trees, clouds, and people engaged in social activities.

artworks.title: Saint Nicholas of Bari
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brush and blue wash, over black chalk, squared in red chalk
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Krugman Family Foundation, Ann and Matthew Nimetz, and Robert B. Loper
artworks.description: The illustration shows a partial figure of a seated person, focusing on the upper body and head. The person is seated in a side profile position, facing right with their head turned slightly towards the viewer. Individual features of the face are visible with a neutral expression. The person wears an elaborate headpiece resembling a bishop’s mitre. The clothing is voluminous, in shades of blue with black outlines, resembling a robe or cloak. The figure holds a book or similar object on their knees with both hands. The background is a plain surface with a faint grid pattern, possibly a preparatory sketch. The paper shows signs of age.

artworks.title: Oberlahnstein on the Rhine
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache over graphite
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with people engaging in various activities near the water's edge. The sky is a mix of pale blues and soft grays with hints of cloud cover. Groups of people are loading goods onto boats by the riverbank, with a few boats visible on the water. On the other side of the river, there is a tower with a reddish-brown roof surrounded by buildings and greenery. The hills slope gently down toward the river, depicted with loose brushstrokes. The color palette consists of earthy browns, soft greens, and blues, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Paddington Fields, London
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on blue paper
artworks.description: This image features a distant view of a broad, flat landscape with a low horizon. Trees create a silhouette at the horizon, and a figure near the center provides scale. The drawing uses a pencil or graphite technique with soft strokes creating textures. The color palette is subdued with a pale blue paper tone.

artworks.title: A View in Italy with Mountains in the Distance
artworks.medium: chalk and stumping, heightened with white gouache on buff paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone in honor of Guy Peppiatt
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon, including buildings with a prominent tower against the sky. Figures are near large trees on the left, with land gently sloping towards the buildings. In the background, there are softly rendered mountains and a sky with pale clouds. The color palette is subdued with grays and earthy browns. The artwork uses soft brushstrokes and shading.

artworks.title: Eel Bucks at Goring
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (top corners rounded off): 36.1 × 53.8 cm (14 3/16 × 21 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene with a bridge, a village in the distance, hills, a church with a tower, tall trees with bare branches, and the river flowing. The brushstrokes are loose and impressionistic, capturing movement of water and clouds. The color palette includes earthy browns, muted greens, blue, and white in the clouds.

artworks.title: Study of a Man Playing a Pipe
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on blue laid paper, laid down on an old album sheet
artworks.description: The image shows an artistic drawing of a muscular man in a dynamic pose. He is depicted standing with one leg crossing over the other, his body slightly turned to the left. The man's head is turned to his left, showing his facial profile with a prominent nose and slightly open mouth. He has curly hair and is naked, with a piece of cloth draped around his back and tied at the waist. The man is holding a long slender object in his right hand. The background is plain with a greyish-blue paper texture and a narrow frame bordering the edges.

artworks.title: A Design for a Wall Decoration or Fountain
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a sculptural niche featuring a central figure of a standing nude woman, flanked by two smaller nude figures on either side. Above the central figure is an ornate cartouche with decorative motifs, and at the top, two small winged figures are present. The sculpture is set within an architectural alcove with columns and arches. The drawing is in a monochromatic sepia tone, indicating it is rendered in ink or wash on paper. The subject within the niche appears intricately designed with flowing drapery and organic forms, giving it a sense of grandeur and elegance as would be seen in a classical architectural setting.

artworks.title: Study of a Standing Male Nude: Saint Sebastian
artworks.medium: black chalk, with stumping, on buff laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a standing male figure. The man has his feet slightly apart, hands behind his back, head turned to the side with a neutral expression. He has wavy shoulder-length hair and a muscular body, without clothing or visible jewelry. He stands against a textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Resurrection of Christ
artworks.medium: crayon manner on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure in a dynamic pose. His left leg is bent, foot on a step, while his right leg is extended back. Both arms are raised above his head, hands open. The man has classical facial features, curly hair, and is nude with a cloth draped behind him. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Title Page: Fishing Boats and Staten Sloop
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a maritime scene with several ships and a large vessel. The point of view is slightly elevated, showing the water with ships in the distance. The horizon is low, revealing sailboats and their sails. The drawing style is intricate with precise linework defining the ships and their details. The color palette is monochromatic with varying tones of brown. In the foreground, a large ship's bow with inscribed text is visible. Smaller boats with sails and figures are also present on the water, leading towards the horizon where more sailboats are seen against the calm sea and sky.

artworks.title: Three Sailing Vessels on Calm Waters
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a seascape with sailing vessels in an etching style. The view is from above water, showing detailed lines. The horizon is above the center with distant boats and clouds. Two large boats with textured sails are on the right, and a smaller boat with fine lines is on the left. The sea has horizontal lines, indicating calmness and reflection. The color scheme is monochromatic, focusing on light paper and dark ink strokes.

artworks.title: Three Sailing Vessels at Choppy Sea
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a marine scene with a high point of view overlooking a choppy sea, displaying waves and sailboats. The horizon is placed above the turbulent waves and three sailboats of different sizes are visible. The artwork is characterized by fine linear etching, depicting detailed textures in the water and clouds. The color palette consists of primarily black and gray shades against a white backdrop, emphasizing form and movement. Large clouds are present in the sky, adding to the sense of drama and movement.

artworks.title: View of Inland Waterway with Fishermen
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with shoreline activities and the sea in the distance. The horizon is in the upper third, with sailing boats. Delicate brushstrokes capture details like water and clouds. The color scheme is mostly black and gray on a beige background. Closer to us, figures are active on the rocky shore, while boats in the distance suggest sea traffic against a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: A "Duinopschuit," a Smaller Sailing Boat, and a Rowboat
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a maritime scene with a calm sea, small boats with triangular sails, distant buildings on the horizon, and two figures in a rowboat. The style is a delicate, monochrome line drawing with a subtle color palette. Minimal clouds and a flock of birds are also present.

artworks.title: Shore of Inland Waterway with a Ketch, Two Smaller Boats, and Fisherman
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is presented in black and white, showcasing a coastal scene with boats. The view is eye-level, focusing on boats and people near the shore. A man is pulling a boat onto the sandy shore, where others stand nearby. In the distance, the sea extends towards the horizon with sailboats and structures visible. The sky is filled with clouds depicted with intricate lines, typical of etching techniques. The image is composed with hatching and cross-hatching lines, creating a classic appearance. The monochrome palette gives a serene visual impact.

artworks.title: Beach Scene with Ketches and other Fishing Boats
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape with boats and fishing activities. The horizon is at a low point in the composition, with sailing vessels and figures engaging in various tasks on the shore and in the sea. A large ship is on the sand nearby, and another ship is sailing close by. Smaller boats are scattered in the shallows, with figures working or interacting. In the distance, smaller vessels can be seen on the calm sea. The sky has scattered clouds, and the illustration features fine etching techniques with precise linear strokes. The color palette is predominantly monochrome, providing a classic and historical impression.

artworks.title: Inland Waterway with Two Galliots at the Right
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with maritime activity. The horizon is low in the composition, featuring ships sailing across the water in the distance. The style uses fine, linear brushstrokes to depict texture and forms, resembling an etching or pen and ink drawing. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and black. Closest to us, figures are seen on a small land area, some by the shore and others in small boats. Further out, larger ships with sails unfurled are visible on the water. The sky has sparse details, with soft clouds drawn with delicate lines.

artworks.title: A Stand of Trees
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper, laid down on old album sheet
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint. Two large trees with textured bark are in the foreground, with detailed leaves. A felled tree is to the right, and more trees are seen in the background with lighter strokes. The scene suggests a forest landscape in graphite gray tones.

artworks.title: Two Boys Standing with Backs Turned
artworks.medium: oil paint counterproof or monotype with gray wash on laid paper, lined or inlaid with Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals captured from the back, with their full bodies visible. Both are standing closely together, leaning slightly forward. The person on the left has medium-length hair that falls naturally down their back, while the right individual's hair is covered by a rounded cap. They are both wearing loose-fitting garments; the left person is wearing a long-sleeved top and a knee-length garment, while the right person has on a similar style with a cap and baggy pants. Both individuals are wearing shoes, similar to clogs, and the feet of the left person are partially crossed as they lean forward. The background is a simple, neutral-toned surface with no additional elements or detailed scenery.

artworks.title: Studies of the Cenotaph of Annia Regilla
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Vincent J. Buonanno
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural elements of a building. The detailed sketches depict a classical building facade with ornate columns, a pediment, and decorative moldings. The architecture features Corinthian columns, with fluted shafts and elaborate capitals, along with architectural ornaments and portions of an arched window or niche. The use of light shading and line work adds depth and detail to the features, creating a study or conceptual drawing of the elements.
